title: Works Fine for Faraway Spaces
text: Works Fine for Faraway Spaces. These do look pretty fake and have a sort of ribbon bow around them.  I ended up putting them on top of my book cases, so you don't get a close up view of how fake they look.  They look good on the bookcase, so just keep in mind that they might be needed for far away spaces.
